title: SpongeBob Sad Song
blurb: A mournful little melody, usually a lone ukulele or steel guitar, deployed by the show whenever things turn genuinely melancholy under the sea. The internet uses it with surgical irony instead: it swells over the pettiest inconveniences imaginable, turning a dropped chip or an unanswered message into a tragedy deserving of a montage and a slow zoom. That contrast between the sincerity of the music and the triviality of the subject is the whole gag. Equal parts nostalgia and comedy, and one of the most requested SpongeBob audios anywhere online.
origin: The melancholy interlude music from SpongeBob SquarePants.
